   - Exported [`reconcileQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-b5k4wjit/packages/query-core/src/persisterRestore.ts#L59-L131) to independently merge data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`), preserving refetch errors, failure counts, timestamps, and invalidation status without wiping out whichever side has the newer data or newer error.
   - Re-exported these helpers from [`packages/query-core/src/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-b5k4wjit/packages/query-core/src/index.ts).
